main_issue: Whether and when Agent D can use the small room for 15-minute daily prayer/chanting slots without clashing with A's client calls, B's file access, and C's private call

A-B.evidence: A objects on call timing (T1, T3) and B on file access (T4, T9); they never address each other, A leaves files to D and B (T22); B's later solution (T23) is not responded to by A.

A-C.evidence: A and C raise separate time conflicts and never address each other; both end up with arrangements that work for them (T8/T20, T19).

A-D.evidence: A rejects 4:30 and the sign (T1, T6); D offers alternatives and A suggests 3:45 (T8); D says 'That time is fine' (T21) and A asks 'is 3.45 okay' (T20).

B-C.evidence: B raises file access (T9, T11) and C a midday call (T12, T14); neither addresses the other, and both end up with workable arrangements.

B-D.evidence: B says any time is a problem (T9, T11); then proposes archiving old files so she won't need the room (T23); D says 'good idea. I can help' (T25) and offers to start now (T27).

C-D.evidence: C says 1 p.m. is a problem (T12); D offers 12:45 or 1:15 and flexibility (T18); C says 'that works for me' (T19).
